journey.title:
SINCE 2005,
NOT JUST STEPS, A JOURNEY OF THE SOUL
journey.description: For Erkin KUNBUK, who met music and dance at a young age, tango is more than a hobby; it is a form of expression. Guiding hundreds of dancers since 2006, Kunbuk built his own style on "freedom loyal to tradition".

primeEra.title:
From Antalya to Buenos Aires:
Global Vision
primeEra.quote: Years spent studying with masters in Buenos Aires, the heart of tango, alongside international events that carried that experience beyond Argentina.
text: Laying the modern foundations of Argentine Tango in Antalya as the co-founder of AÜ and Tango Siete, Erkin KUNBUK not only trained hundreds of dancers in this period but also created his unique style by working with the greatest masters of the traditional school in Buenos Aires.
By taking the stage as an Instructor and DJ in international organizations, he became a global figure bringing Argentine Tango to the masses.

timeline.title: Fethiye: Adaptation and Deepening
timeline.desc: Developing and refining a boutique teaching approach in Fethiye, with a growing focus on individual technique.

timeline.title: Cultural Heritage & Collaboration
timeline.desc: Helped grow the local community through the 'Fethiye Tango Culture' initiative founded by Bülent Baştürk, bringing tradition and a more modern club culture together.

timeline.title: Fethiye Tango Club
timeline.desc: Building Fethiye Tango Club on 20 years of experience and the legacy of hundreds of students, with a clear methodology for teaching tango.

trainers.seoDescription: Meet Fethiye Tango Club founder and head instructor Erkin Kunbuk, and explore his tango journey, teaching method, and Buenos Aires-inspired approach.

atolye.title: COLLECTIVE LAB

themes.title: BODY AWARENESS
themes.lead: Low-tempo exercises focused on breathing, pivots and connection with the floor. We work on finding your own balance before creating a stable connection with a partner, refining your axis, reducing wasted effort and exploring the body's biomechanics through tango.

themes.title: COMMUNICATION & INTENTION
themes.lead: Variations focused on creating a shared dance rather than simply following fixed leader/follower roles. We explore how intention becomes movement, how a partner reads that intention, and how genuine connection replaces force.

themes.title: MUSICALITY LABORATORY
themes.lead: Layer-by-layer rhythm work with bandoneon recordings. We explore the relationship between melody and rhythm, phrasing, and the distinctive character of Golden Age tango orchestras.
